Pairwise ordered isotropy implies orthogonal coordinate projections when \(\lambda^2\ne1\); the vector-space Goursat count proves the generic expression. Hyperbolic orthogonal/symplectic ordered frame counts prove exceptional branches. Direct finite-field Gaussian/RREF enumeration over fields of orders three, four, five, and seven and brute-force endomorphism checks in dimension three agree. Finite tests are corroboration only; no unproved infinite extrapolation is used.
